claims.claim: Izutech solar energy specialize in all solar equipment such as inverter, panels, charge controllers.
claims.evidence: The photos show only two solar panels; no business signage, documents, or other equipment is visible.
No battery appears in the witness report; only solar panels are shown.
No battery or charge test is shown in the photos.
Photos cannot reveal repair history; no service records or labels are visible.

risks.risk: Brand and model are unreadable or absent.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of any label, sticker, or engraving on the panel frame or backsheet.

risks.risk: Wattage or power output is unknown.
risks.proof: Photo of the specification label showing wattage, or a screenshot of the datasheet for the visible model.

risks.risk: Panels may not work or may have cracks, delamination, or water damage.
risks.proof: Video of the panels connected to a charge controller or multimeter producing power, plus close-up photos of the cell surface and edges.

risks.risk: Age and usage history are unknown.
risks.proof: Photo of manufacture date sticker or original purchase receipt.

risks.risk: Mounting brackets, cables, or connectors may not be included.
risks.proof: Photo showing all accessories laid out next to the panels.
Warranty card or screenshot of valid warranty registration.

proof_requests: Clear close-up of any brand or model label on the panels.
Photo of the specification label showing wattage.
Video of the panels producing power under sunlight.
Photo of all included cables, connectors, and brackets.
Photo of manufacture date or purchase receipt.
response.reason: The witness identifies two solar panels, so the item can be priced at its worst case; seller claims about a battery and repair history cannot be verified from the panel photos.
